summary: @servicetitan/micro-frontend preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`, which on `npm install` downloads the Bun runtime zip from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, extracts the `bun`/`bun.exe` binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and immediately invokes it against the bundled `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated file using obfuscator-style variable renaming and an array-rotation string-table cipher (`function WV8StW(...) {... MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift());... }`), with no readable URLs or symbols and no reference from the library's own `dist/index.js` entry. The advertised purpose is a micro-frontend integration library, which has no legitimate need for a shipped Bun runtime or an opaque preinstall payload. The package is published under the `@servicetitan` scope and points at `github.com/servicetitan/playground.git`, but the shipped behavior is inconsistent with a first-party ServiceTitan library, indicating scope impersonation to widen blast radius. The alternate-runtime step evades static scanners that only trace Node-resolved code, and execution is automatic at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
